kapak.alt: The I-V interval in asymmetric loss

youtube.baslik: If the ABR is normal, is a small tumor ruled out? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In the example ABR, the I-V interval is about 4 milliseconds in the right ear, while in the left ear wave V is delayed and the I-V interval is about 4.8 milliseconds; an I-V interval above about 4.4 to 4.5 milliseconds suggests a retrocochlear delay. But with small tumors the ABR can be normal; a normal ABR does not replace imaging. The physician decides on imaging; the gold standard is MRI with contrast or special sequences.
